segments.headline: Code that controls the real world
segments.say: Want to make real electronics do what your code says? This is ESP32 From Zero.

segments.headline: Start from zero
segments.say: If you know a little C, you're ready. We start at zero: installing the tools, and your very first upload.

segments.headline: Real circuits, step by step
segments.say: Then we build real circuits on a breadboard, step by step, and learn why every part is there.

segments.headline: The code, line by line
segments.say: We write the code together, line by line, and upload it to the board.

segments.headline: What you'll build
segments.say: Buttons and timers, dimming and colors, sensors, a little screen, WiFi, and a web page on your phone.

segments.headline: Start with episode 1
segments.say: All the code is on GitHub. Subscribe, and start with episode one.
